title: Password-based admin unlock for existing admin dashboard

requirements.summary: Add a simple admin password unlock on /admin using the exact password "admin 9828" to enable access to existing admin dashboard and menu management routes.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user visits /admin and is not yet authorized, the UI provides an input for an admin password (not "token")
Entering the exact password "admin 9828" and submitting results in the user becoming authorized as an admin for the current session and gaining access to the admin dashboard routes
After successful password submission, the admin check succeeds (no more "Access Denied" / "Admin token required" blocking state)
If the password is incorrect, the UI shows a clear error message and admin access is not granted
Admin authorization remains enforced for all admin-only backend methods (category/item CRUD, reordering, analytics)

file_operations.description: Update the /admin guard to accept an Admin Password and validate it client-side against the exact string "admin 9828"; on success, store it under the existing secret key (caffeineAdminToken), trigger actor recreation, and automatically re-check admin status to unlock the nested admin routes. On failure, show a clear English error message and do not persist the secret. Use the selected authorization component’s admin-check flow (isCallerAdmin + guarded admin routes) as the enforcement mechanism; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/align a setSecretParameter helper (used by AdminRouteGuard) that persists the provided secret into sessionStorage under the given key (caffeineAdminToken) without requiring URL edits, keeping the existing getSecretParameter behavior intact.

requirements.summary: Replace "Admin Token" wording with clear English password-based copy on the /admin access screen.
acceptanceCriteria: On the /admin guard screen, labels/placeholder/button text use "Admin Password" / "Enter admin password" / "Submit Password" (or equivalent) instead of "Admin Token"
Any error/help text displayed to the user is in English

file_operations.description: Revise the unauthorized/admin-denied UI copy to consistently say “Admin Password” (labels, placeholders, CTA button) and ensure all help/error text is clear English; keep the principal display/copy section optional but ensure any visible text remains English.

requirements.summary: Integrate password submission with existing session-based secret storage so the actor is recreated and admin status is rechecked automatically after submit and across refresh within the same session.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the admin password stores it in session storage under the existing secret key used for admin initialization ("caffeineAdminToken")
After submission, the frontend refreshes/recreates the backend actor and re-runs the admin check automatically
A page refresh during the same browser session keeps the admin access working (until the session ends/clears)

file_operations.description: Enhance the actor refresh helper so AdminRouteGuard can reliably trigger actor recreation and then re-run dependent admin checks (e.g., provide an async refresh that invalidates and refetches the actor query), ensuring the post-password flow works without manual navigation.

After storing the admin password under caffeineAdminToken, call the improved actor refresh mechanism and then automatically re-run the admin check (useIsCallerAdmin refetch) without requiring URL edits; keep behavior compatible with the authorization component’s admin gating. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm and, if needed, adjust the actor initialization path to continue reading the persisted secret from session storage via getSecretParameter('caffeineAdminToken') so refreshes within the same browser session preserve admin access.
